cited.quote: foreign languages such as French, German and Japanese are being taught to the final year students

rationale: C3 reports a dedicated foreign-language teaching programme (French, German, Japanese) for final-year students in 10 Government Engineering Colleges to help employment, with 600 students benefitted in 2022-23. Directional promise, so a dedicated measure suffices, though scope is limited and no GO date is shown.

cited.quote: In the first phase, this system has been implemented in 47 senior grade temples.
were launched by the Hon’ble Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu on 12.08.2021

rationale: C1 reports the Annai Tamizhil Archanai system implemented in 47 senior temples in a first phase, with Tamil archanai books launched on 12.08.2021. Later notes (C2-C5) say Tamil archanai continues. Scope beyond first phase is not shown; launch date taken from C1.

cited.quote: implementation of the UGSS in 13 wards is in progress
One of the main objective of the Government of Tamil Nadu is eradication of manual scavenging.

rationale: C2 shows underground sewerage works under way in a city (13 wards in progress; UGSS in ongoing projects). C4 shows mechanisation of Chennai sewer maintenance to eradicate manual scavenging. No extract shows the statewide replacement of open drainage or job transfer; works are ongoing, not complete.

cited.quote: have been called and are due in April, 2022
Major bridge projects, currently under execution are given in the table 3.2.

rationale: C1 reports tenders called for flyovers/subways in Chennai; C2 (2024-01) lists major bridge projects still under execution. No extract shows pending projects completed. C4 and C5 concern Vellore-division ROBs, not Chennai.

cited.quote: World class Keeladi Museum established in Kondagai, Sivagangi District at a cost of Rs.18.42
a museum is being built on 13 acres of land in Kulavanigarpuram village, Tirunelveli district
the world-class Keezhadi and the Porunai Museums have already been opened to the public

rationale: C5 shows the Keeladi Museum established and inaugurated on 05.03.2023. C3 shows the Porunai Museum for Korkai, Adichanallur and Sivakalai artefacts being built; C1 (2026-02) says Keezhadi and Porunai Museums are open. Earliest operationalisation is the Keeladi inauguration.

cited.quote: It is proposed to increase the generation capacity by not only taking action for completion of
is taking all measures on a war footing basis to ensure Renewable Purchase Obligation compliance

rationale: C1 only states a proposal to complete thermal projects on a war footing; C5 says a corporation is acting on a war footing for RPO compliance. Neither is an order by the electricity board scaling up generation and distribution on a wartime basis. C2 and C3 concern powerloom subsidy.

cited.quote: 1,248 camps were conducted benefitting 8,64,934 persons as on 31.03.2022

rationale: C2 shows the Varumun Kappom scheme (now named after Kalaignar) running camps in 2021-22, but no extract shows an official restructuring step such as a GO. C1, C3 are about a housing scheme; C4, C5 about an urban scheme. Related activity only.

cited.quote: Conducting Coaching Classes for Competitive Examinations through separate Channel for Education of Kalvi Television
Need based special Coaching Centres are also functioning in Chennai

rationale: C4 is a GO of 07.01.2022 sanctioning Rs.50 lakh for the Employment wing to run coaching classes for competitive exams; C3 shows employment and career guidance centres running Study Circles and coaching centres with sanctioned funds. Coaching through employment centres is operating; the practice partly predates this government.

cited.quote: is focused on enhancing power infrastructure and ensuring uninterrupted power supply to industries

rationale: C2 only states TNPDCL is focused on power infrastructure for industries. C1 and C3 describe general distribution upgrades (substations, transformers, underground cable), not new lines to industries or industrial estates. C4 and C5 are industrial estate GOs unrelated to power lines.

cited.quote: gave appointment orders to 15 Othuvars including 5 female othuvars directly appointed.

rationale: Extracts show only small appointments (15 Othuvars, archakas) and existing staffing (668 executive officers, conservation wing posts). Nothing shows an order to appoint 25,000 youth as temple employees.

cited.quote: Conduct of free Coaching Classes for Competitive exams through Study Circles

rationale: All extracts concern coaching for TNPSC, SSC, RRB, IBPS and UPSC type government job exams. None shows coaching for IIT, NIT, AIIMS or IIM entrance in district headquarters. Related activity on a different exam group.

cited.quote: establish farm machinery banks (custom hiring centres) upto a project cost of Rs.10.00 Lakh each

rationale: C1, C2, C5 sanction farm machinery banks and hiring hubs under SMAM, which are custom hiring centres, not a manufacturing plant. C3 and C4 mention Erode dairy facilities (cattle feed, silage). No extract shows a farm machinery manufacturing plant in Erode.

cited.quote: Out of the 2,212 water bodies across 490 town panchayats, 1,182 have already been restored.
it is imperative to rejuvenate all water bodies in the rural areas in a holistic manner

rationale: C1 reports water body rejuvenation works in town panchayats from 2021-22 under KNMT and other schemes; C4 is a GO (2023-02-13) re-implementing the rural scheme with a water body rejuvenation component. Dedicated measures exist; year taken from the 2021-22 table in C1.

cited.quote: has developed the Chennai Trade Centre at Chennai.

rationale: The extracts discuss only the Chennai Trade Centre expansion. None shows a trade centre for Madurai, Tuticorin, Tiruppur or Erode. C2 is a logistics policy and C5 a ports policy, neither a trade centre step.

The promise does not say which provision is to be repealed, so no extract can be matched to it. The extracts are GST rule amendments and a policy note with no reference to a repeal step for an identifiable provision.

cited.quote: Rehabilitation of Palar river from Devalapuram Village to Malligaithoppu Village by removing encroachments

rationale: C3 sanctions Palar river rehabilitation works, and C1, C4 describe Thamirabarani link schemes, but none is a measure for restoring or expanding an integrated Palar-Thamirabarani riverbed management project. C2 concerns the Palar dispute with Andhra Pradesh. Only related activity.

cited.quote: permit the sale of Palm Jaggery through select Fair Price Shops run by Cooperatives
Palm products are being sold in Khadi Krafts, Palm Crafts and in PDS shops

rationale: C1 is G.O. (Ms) No.75 dated 30.09.2021 permitting sale of palm jaggery through select fair price shops and Amutham shops on a pilot basis. C5 confirms palm products sold in PDS shops. For a directional promise this dedicated GO suffices.

cited.quote: 1,800 litres for 10 months except two months of fishing ban period

rationale: C1 shows the 1,800 litres per month ceiling continuing in 2022-23. C4 reports an enhancement only to 19,000 litres per year for mechanized boats, not a rise to 2,000 litres. C2 and C5 are GST rate notifications. No extract shows the promised increase.

cited.quote: Permission to upscale the Organized Cancer Screening Programme to the entire State of Tamil Nadu
Clinical breast examinations (CBEs) being the screening method for Breast Cancer is done at all health facilities in NCD clinic

rationale: C4 is a GO of 05.03.2025 upscaling organized cancer screening statewide in phases; C1 reports NCD and cancer screening at health facilities; C2 notes colposcopy in all district and taluk hospitals but mammograms in only 13 DHQHs. Screening and diagnosis exist but not in all government hospitals. The meaning of the same is unclear.

cited.quote: Totally 13 Meritorious Sportspersons are appointed under 3% Sports Quota in Government
comprehensive guidelines are proposed for implementation across the State

rationale: C2 and C3 describe a 3% sports quota from G.O.Ms.No.6 dated 20.2.2019, before this government took office, and C2 says new comprehensive guidelines are only proposed. C1, C4, C5 are cash incentives and scholarships. No new employment order by this government is shown.
